description: Registry of all available mock services for the Event Service

mockServiceRelationships.description: Event Service consumes position data from Position Service
Event Service publishes detected events to Notification Service
Event Service uses Message Broker for asynchronous communication
Event Service registers with Service Discovery for service location
Event Service calls external HTTP services for additional data

mockServiceCapabilities.notification-delivery-simulation: Simulates the delivery of notifications through various channels
mockServiceCapabilities.channel-specific-behaviors: Simulates behavior specific to different notification channels
mockServiceCapabilities.failure-scenarios: Simulates various failure modes for testing error handling
mockServiceCapabilities.position-data-simulation: Generates simulated position data for testing
mockServiceCapabilities.position-history-retrieval: Simulates retrieval of historical position data
mockServiceCapabilities.position-enrichment: Simulates enrichment of position data with additional information
mockServiceCapabilities.device-state-tracking: Tracks device state for stateful event detection
mockServiceCapabilities.topic-simulation: Simulates message broker topics for publishing and subscribing
mockServiceCapabilities.message-validation: Validates message format and content against schemas
mockServiceCapabilities.consumer-group-simulation: Simulates consumer group behavior for message partitioning
mockServiceCapabilities.dead-letter-queue-support: Supports dead-letter queues for failed message handling
mockServiceCapabilities.service-registration: Simulates service registration with discovery service
mockServiceCapabilities.service-discovery: Simulates discovery of services by name or metadata
mockServiceCapabilities.health-check-simulation: Simulates health check responses for services
mockServiceCapabilities.http-request-matching: Matches HTTP requests based on patterns
mockServiceCapabilities.response-templating: Generates dynamic responses based on templates
mockServiceCapabilities.network-delay-simulation: Simulates network delays for realistic testing
mockServiceCapabilities.fault-injection: Injects faults to test error handling

testScenarios.event-notification-delivery: Tests the delivery of notifications triggered by events
testScenarios.notification-failure-handling: Tests handling of notification delivery failures
testScenarios.multi-channel-notification: Tests notification delivery through multiple channels
testScenarios.geofence-event-detection: Tests detection of geofence entry/exit events
testScenarios.motion-event-detection: Tests detection of motion start/stop events
testScenarios.overspeed-event-detection: Tests detection of speed threshold violation events
testScenarios.position-consumption: Tests consumption of position data from the message broker
testScenarios.event-publishing: Tests publishing of detected events to the message broker
testScenarios.broker-failure-recovery: Tests recovery from message broker failures
testScenarios.discovery-failure-handling: Tests handling of service discovery failures
testScenarios.external-service-integration: Tests integration with external HTTP services
testScenarios.http-error-handling: Tests handling of HTTP errors from external services
testScenarios.circuit-breaker-testing: Tests circuit breaker behavior for external service calls
